author: NotPineapple203
body:
I was playing around in the map i was building then i came up with the idea of elytra in a dtm form. now obviously you couldnt use them in normal dtm maps or skybridges would become the new craze. But i was thinking if you took away the blocks  in a special dtm map you could make it to where elytra flying is necessary (e.g. impossible jumps, tight fly spaces, etc). For instance you could have parkour or teleports or slime launchers to get you air. You could also have a map that drastically varies in altitude to allow for more fly changes. 

Again this was just an idea I thought would be cool and since the server hasn't changed to 1.9+ only then  will you be able to even think of the thought of this gametype.
